content:
rachel: Quick sync — PMs want a short changelog entry + micro-migration for the new routing flag. Release window: 2026-04-30. Docs PR needed by 2026-04-25.

dave: I can author the PR. What should we call the flag? product suggested `routing.prefer_latency`.

sophie: Eng confirmation: `routing.prefer_latency` (bool, default false). When true, router favors latency-optimized variants and will only fall back to cost-optimized variants if latency targets cannot be met. Behavioral note: streaming + fallback can emit a small partial chunk before fallback completes.

alan: Draft changelog sentence: "Latency-first routing (opt-in): add routing.prefer_latency to favor low-latency model variants; existing behavior unchanged unless you opt in."

dave: I'll include two micro-snippets (JS + Python) and a one-liner migration note about prefix caching. JS snippet: ```js
// JS SDK v2: enable latency-first routing
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'rwk-1', prompt: 'Notes', routing: { prefer_latency: true } });
console.log(r.text);
```

alan: Cache note: enabling prefer_latency can increase model-family variance which may reduce prefix/KV cache hit rate temporarily; expect small token cost changes while caches warm.

sophie: Add known issue: "Streaming: small partial chunk may appear when fallback occurs. If your app requires atomic streams, either disable streaming for now or set retry_on_fallback: true."

ci-bot: branch created: refs/heads/docs/latency-optin-apr30 by dave (CI queued).

dave: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/520 — draft changelog, JS+Python snippets, migration anchor (/docs/migrate/latency-first). Tagging @sophie for tech signoff and @alan for copy review.

sophie: quick technical LGTM. tiny clarification on timing: partial chunk typically <200ms before fallback output.

alan: applied copy tweaks. plan: merge after green CI and staging preview. target merge 2026-04-24.

rachel: great — once merged we'll notify support and include the changelog line in /docs/changelog/2026-04.md.

dave: merging after CI. Thanks team!
